service.description: A draft purchase request (RqtPurchase) of one of the user's organizations, filed by the user: the organization as its OrgInternal RequestParty, the purpose (requestCategoryId), project (rootWorkEffortId), facility, currency (the buying policy's, else the organization's accounting currency) and response date; its lines are added with store#PurchaseRequestItem. Refuses an organization outside the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), another organization's facility (FACILITY_INVALID) and an unknown currency, project or purpose (CURRENCY_INVALID, PROJECT_INVALID, CATEGORY_INVALID).

A line of a draft or submitted purchase request, new or changed: a product usable for buying (check#ProductUsable, usage Purchase; PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE) or a description, the quantity and its unit (the product's by default), the required date (the request's response date by default), a supplier the organization may buy from (SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE), the cost centre (the organization or one rolling up to it, COST_CENTER_INVALID), carried to the purchase order line, and the most to pay for the line (maximumAmount). A change to a submitted request is a new revision, sent to its approvers again. On an approved request (In Progress) a buyer chooses only a line's supplier and cost centre (REQUEST_APPROVED for another field). The request's requester or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a closed request (REQUEST_CLOSED), a line not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), a line with neither product nor description (ITEM_INVALID), an unknown unit (UOM_INVALID) and a quantity that is not above zero (QUANTITY_INVALID).

A draft purchase request's line removed. The request's requester or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses a submitted request (REQUEST_NOT_DRAFT: change the line instead) and a line not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE).

Submit a draft purchase request for approval: Submitted, and the step waiting sent to its approvers on the PurchaseRequestApproval topic (the organization's PasRequest approval policy rows for the lines' maximum amounts, else one step by any purchase approver). The request's requester or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a request that is not a draft (NOT_DRAFT), one with no lines (NO_ITEMS) and a line with no quantity or with neither product nor description (ITEM_INVALID).

A purchase approver's decision on the step waiting of a submitted purchase request at its revision (the PurchaseRequestApproval topic's approve#PurchaseSource and refuse#PurchaseSource call it). The decision is kept as a PurchaseApprovalDecision bound to the revision. A refusal, with its reason, leaves the request Submitted (Request has no Rejected status); an approval that leaves a step waiting sends it to its approvers. The last step's approval makes each line one approved Requirement (RqTpProduct for a product line, else RqTpInternal; RqmtStApproved) linked through RequirementRequestItem, with the organization as its OrgInternal RequirementParty, reserves each line's maximum amount at the request stage where its account is under an approved budget (mantle.other.BudgetServices.reserve#Commitment, keyed by the revision: a Stop refuses with BUDGET_EXCEEDED unless a BUDGET_OVERRIDE holder gives budgetOverrideReason), and puts the request In Progress, ready to source. The same operation key answers the first result. Requires PURCHASE_APPROVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a request outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not submitted (NOT_SUBMITTED), a revision that is not the current one (STALE_REVISION), POLICY_MISSING, NOT_ELIGIBLE, SELF_APPROVAL (its filer or submitter), ALREADY_DECIDED, SEPARATION_REQUIRED, REASON_REQUIRED and DECISION_INVALID.

parameter.name: sourceRevision
parameter.description: The revision reviewed; the current one when empty

service.description: Cancel an open purchase request with its reason (kept on the status change's audit row): its demand not yet sourced is released (a requirement with nothing covered Rejected, one partly covered cut to what is covered) with what is left of its budget commitments (release#ClosedSourceCommitments); the live purchase orders made from it are named (orderIds) for the buyer to decide on, and stay. The request's requester or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and a completed or cancelled request (REQUEST_CLOSED).

Complete an approved purchase request with something sourced (impl-purchasing P17, F127; design RequestDetail: fulfilled, or explicitly closed with a reason): with no reason once every line is received in full, else with a reason, kept on the status change's audit row. A line sourced below its approved quantity gives up the rest (its requirement cut to what is covered, Ordered, or Rejected with nothing covered), the request's commitments still reserved are released (release#ClosedSourceCommitments, the unsourced remainder held at the request stage) and its plan supply ends, as cancel#PurchaseRequest does. The purchase orders made from it stay. The request's requester or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a request not approved (REQUEST_NOT_APPROVED), a completed or cancelled one (REQUEST_CLOSED), one with nothing sourced (NOTHING_SOURCED: cancel it instead) and one not received in full without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED, naming the lines).

A purchase request's progress (crosscut §3.11 PurchaseSourcingProgress; CX-REQUEST: a purchase request follows its sourcing, never its linked work): each line's requested quantity and unit, supplier, cost centre and maximum, the approved quantity of its requirement, what is sourced (RequirementSupply), ordered and received on its purchase order lines (RequestItemOrder) and what remains to source; the request's revision, its approval (state, step waiting, decisions, whether the user may decide) and the actions the user may take. Supplier prices are not in it. The request's people, or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, PURCHASE_APPROVE, SUPPLY_PLAN_VIEW or SUPPLY_PLAN_RUN (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a request outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).
The approved request lines a sourcing takes: by key, by line with its supplier, quantity and route, or every line of the requests.

parameter.name: requestItemKeys
parameter.description: requestId:requestItemSeqId, a list or comma separated

parameter.name: lines
parameter.description: Maps of requestId, requestItemSeqId and optionally supplierPartyId, quantity (at most what remains; what remains by default) and route (po, or dropship for a line for a customer order line)

service.description: The sourcing of approved request lines explained, writing nothing (design RequestSourcing SourceDemand and SourceGroups): each line's required, sourced and remaining quantity, supplier and route, ready or why not (NOT_APPROVED, ALREADY_SOURCED, MISSING_SUPPLIER, PRODUCT_REQUIRED, NO_CUSTOMER_LINE; EXISTING once this operation sourced it), and the supplier groups a conversion makes on the result envelope, each with the buying policy's supplier check (a Stop fails it, a Warn is its message) and, for a supplier-price reader, its lines' prices and amount. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses no line (DEMAND_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: groupRows
parameter.description: The result envelope of each group: operationId, supplierGroupId, supplierPartyId, sourceRevision, requestItemKeys, requirementIds, requestedQuantity, allocatedQuantity, quantityUomId, resultStatus (READY, EXISTING, FAILED), orderId, orderPartSeqId, rfqRequestId, errorCode, errorMessage, retryable; a ready group's supplierResult, supplierMessage, lineRows, amountText and dueText.

service.description: Source approved request lines to draft purchase orders (design RequestSourcing ConvertDemand; R-PUR-01, R-PUR-06), in place of create#PurchaseRequestOrder for BOSS (F4): one draft purchase order (OrderOpen) per organization, supplier, receiving facility and route, each group in its own transaction (convert#PurchaseSourcingGroup) under the lock of its requirements' remaining quantity, made through create#PurchaseOrder and store#PurchaseOrderItem (the supplier check, product usability, the supplier's price and the line's cost centre and unit), with a RequestItemOrder and a RequirementSupply for each line; a line for a customer order line may take the drop-ship route (route#OrderItemToDropShip). A group fails by name with its reason (MISSING_SUPPLIER for lines with no supplier, ALREADY_SOURCED, a supplier Stop, PRICE_UNAVAILABLE...) and the others go on; a retry with the same operation key repeats only the failures, the earlier successes answering their orders (EXISTING); another operation is refused the quantity already sourced (ALREADY_SOURCED). Nothing is placed or approved (PLACE_NOT_ALLOWED for placeAndApproveOrders). Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses no operation key (OPERATION_KEY_REQUIRED) and no line (DEMAND_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Each group's result envelope (resultStatus CREATED, EXISTING or FAILED), as preview#PurchaseSourcing's groupRows.

service.description: Internal to convert#PurchaseSourcing, which runs it in a transaction of its own per supplier group: the group's requirements locked in id order, each line read again (its refusal by name), the draft purchase order and its lines (or the drop-ship route) and the lineage. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT.
